title: Derived mate transport at the upper-left vertex
statement: Choose derived categories of modules [def-pc-derived-category] on schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to S\prime$ satisfy $h:pf=qg$. Let $e:X\prime\cong P$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$ with $ep=g\prime$, $eq=f\prime$, and $h\prime:g\prime f=f\prime g$. There exist natural isomorphisms $j:Lg\prime^*\,Re_*\cong Lp^*$ and $k:Rf\prime_*\cong Re_*\,Rq_*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] such that for every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $\beta(h\prime)_E\,k_{Lg\prime^*E}\,Rq_*(j_E)=\beta(h)_E$ for the pinned derived mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No cartesian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit description; Lemmas 20.27.2 (0D5S) and 20.28.2 (0D5T), composition

proof.text: The chosen coherent pullback comparisons for e.hom and e.inv and their identity comparisons exhibit inverse equivalences. By uniqueness of the pinned right adjoint, Re_* is the inverse of Le^*. Compose the pullback comparison for ep=gprime with the inverse of the pinned adjunction unit to define j. The right-adjoint mate of the pullback comparison for eq=fprime defines k.

Transpose the proposed equality under Lq^* adjoint to Rq_*. The mate formula for k identifies the left transpose with Re_* applied to the transpose under Lfprime^* adjoint to Rfprime_*, followed by j. Substitute the pinned counit description of the base-change map. Naturality of j moves the counit of f past j. The associativity law for pullback comparison along e.hom, q and g, and the two unit laws, identify the remaining comparison with the comparison for the original square. This is the right transpose; injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives equality.

theorem exists_derivedBaseChange_top_iso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S P S' X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (p : P ⟶ X) (q : P ⟶ S') (h : p ≫ f = q ≫ g)
    (e : X' ≅ P) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (hp : e.hom ≫ p = g') (hq : e.hom ≫ q = f')
    (h' : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) :
    ∃ j : derivedPullback g' ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ≅ derivedPullback p,
    ∃ k : schemeDerivedDirectImage f' ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage q,
      ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h' E ≫
            k.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj E) ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage q).map (j.hom.app E) =
          schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f q g p h E
